questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Zoetis, Neogen Genomics and/or GenomNZ.
Does Zoetis supply products or services other than genomic or genetic testing services to your business or organisation? Please provide a description of these products and services.
Describe the extent to which, and how, Zoetis’ remedy offer would address any competition concerns you have in relation to the Acquisition for beef and/or dairy cattle.
Outline any concerns you consider would not be resolved by the divestiture of the Divestiture Business.
Provide your views on the qualities a suitable purchaser should possess to ensure this business remained competitive post-Acquisition.
What type of laboratory facilities and field sales staffing capabilities do you consider a suitable purchaser would require to be successful?

What are the key assets, SNP chips, rights and personnel required to ensure a potential purchaser of the Divestiture Business can become a viable, effective, and long-term competitor in the supply of genomic testing for cattle in Australia?
Provide your view on the value of the HD50K, SIRETRACE and Angus HeiferSELECT products to genomic testing customers, and identify the available alternative options to these products.

Provide your views on whether the Divestiture Business would need to include any other products to become a viable, effective, and long-term competitor in the supply of genomic testing for cattle in Australia.
Provide your views on whether GenomNZ is a suitable purchaser of the Divestiture Business.

Provide your view on any factors that may impact effective implementation of the remedy offer e.g., undertaking drafting and any third-party consents (including regulatory) required, and its ability to address the competition concerns associated with the Acquisition.
Provide any additional information or comments you consider relevant to the ACCC’s consideration of the remedy offer.
